scripts.install-all: powershell -c "Get-ChildItem -Path . -Filter \"package.json\" -Recurse -Depth 2 | ForEach-Object { $dir = $_.DirectoryName; Write-Host \"--- Installing in $dir ---\" -ForegroundColor Green; Push-Location $dir; npm install; Pop-Location } | Out-Null; Write-Host \"--- All installations complete! ---\" -ForegroundColor Green"
